context: Evaluates correct implementation of instanced mesh ring rendering along the procedural tunnel curve. Tests that THREE.InstancedMesh is used for performance, that ring positions use InfiniteCurve.getPointAtZ(), that orientations use getTangentAtZ() with quaternion alignment, and that warp density adjustment is implemented.

checklist.name: InstancedMesh Usage
checklist.description: THREE.InstancedMesh is used with TorusGeometry for rendering all rings in a single draw call, not individual mesh components

checklist.name: getPointAtZ Positioning
checklist.description: InfiniteCurve.getPointAtZ(ringZ) from useWormholeMeta().infiniteCurve is used to set each ring's world-space position

checklist.name: getTangentAtZ Orientation
checklist.description: InfiniteCurve.getTangentAtZ(ringZ) is used with THREE.Quaternion.setFromUnitVectors to orient each ring perpendicular to the tunnel

checklist.name: Boundary Hiding
checklist.description: Rings beyond InfiniteCurve.getMaxZ() are hidden by setting their matrix scale to zero via dummy.scale.setScalar(0), not by reducing ringCount

checklist.name: Warp Density Adjustment
checklist.description: Ring spacing is reduced during warp by interpolating between base spacing and WARP_CONFIG.RING_SPACING_WARP based on warpIntensity
